# Health plan summary

Blue Ridge PPO, from the summary of benefits and coverage.

## Costs at a glance

Deductible $1,500 for one person and $3,000 for a family. Out-of-pocket maximum $5,000 and $10,000. Copays: primary care $25, specialist $50, urgent care $75, emergency room $300 (waived if admitted). After the deductible the plan pays 80% of most in-network services.

## In-network and out-of-network

In-network providers have agreed to the plan's rates. Out-of-network care costs 40% coinsurance after a separate $3,000 deductible, and the provider may bill the difference between its charge and the plan's allowed amount.

## Prior authorization

MRIs, CT scans, surgery and some drugs need approval before the service. The doctor's office asks for it, and the plan answers within 5 business days. If it is turned down, the doctor can ask for a peer-to-peer review within 14 days.

## Prescriptions

Generic drugs $10, preferred brand $40, non-preferred brand $80, specialty drugs 25% up to $250. Mail-order gives 90 days for the price of 60.

## Preventive care

The annual physical, vaccines and recommended screenings are $0 in-network and do not count against the deductible.

## Denied claims and appeals

If the plan denies or underpays a claim for care you already had, you have 180 days from the date of the denial notice to file an appeal. Send a letter with the claim number, the doctor's note and any records. The plan decides within 30 days, and if the appeal fails you can ask for an outside external review.
